context: Tests a TypeScript Marketplace action release with bundled runtime, App-signed source writeback, and a maintained moving-major-tag handoff.

checklist.name: Bundled entrypoint
checklist.description: action.yml runs dist/index.js or another bundled path, never src/index.ts.

checklist.name: Build verification
checklist.description: Verification removes dist, rebuilds the TypeScript bundle, and requires an empty scoped porcelain status with untracked files included, proving the checked-in tree has no changed, missing, stale, or new outputs.

checklist.name: Moving major tag
checklist.description: A maintained plugin or small tested repo-owned action updates v<major>; workflow YAML does not contain inline force-push shell.

checklist.name: Durable major-tag repair
checklist.description: The major-tag updater is gated by durable exact-tag/release state and idempotently repairs a missing pointer on later recovery runs; it does not rely solely on new_release_published.

checklist.name: Signed writeback plugin
checklist.description: The workflow installs @jno21/semantic-release-github-commit@1.0.1 and .releaserc uses it plus @semantic-release/github.

checklist.name: Plugin order
checklist.description: A deterministic prepare step actually updates each listed version manifest before the GitHub commit plugin, which precedes @semantic-release/github.

checklist.name: Writeback options
checklist.description: The GitHub commit plugin lists only existing regular version manifests updated by prepare, uses commitMessage containing [skip ci], and does not use dist/**, assets, or message.

checklist.name: App-signed boundary
checklist.description: Plugin v1.0.1 runs only under an enforced exclusive-writer interval that starts before semantic-release release analysis and lasts through the plugin API ref update, with a scoped release App token and no custom identity; checkout persists no credentials and an immediate if: always() cleanup restores a credential-free origin.

checklist.name: skip ci guards
checklist.description: Verify and release both skip [skip ci] writeback commits.

checklist.name: Release concurrency
checklist.description: Release has a job-level non-cancellable concurrency group.

checklist.name: Full history
checklist.description: Verify and release checkouts use fetch-depth: 0.

checklist.name: Pinned release action
checklist.description: cycjimmy/semantic-release-action is pinned to a full commit SHA with an exact version comment.

checklist.name: Immutable completion proof
checklist.description: The workflow reads back immutable: true, runs gh release verify, proves the exact release tag, verified writeback, bundled runtime, and moving major tag agree, and implements exact-tag backfill plus parity reread for a missing metadata-only Release without another bump or published-release mutation.
